format_coverage: The real CLF-C02 exam uses exactly two item types: multiple choice (one correct response and three distractors) and multiple response (two or more correct responses among five or more response options). The exam guide names no other type. Both map 1:1 onto Mockka formats, so this mock reproduces 100% of the exam's item types — the exam's formats are a strict subset of Mockka's three. Mockka's third format, scenario_matching, is NOT a CLF-C02 item type and is set to 0 in every domain; it must not be used for this exam. Two fidelity caveats stand: (1) the blueprint permits multiple-response items with more than two keys and more than five options, but all 80 items across the three registered practice sources are choose-2-of-5, so the corpus supplies no calibration for wider items — the select_count and options values above are the corpus's shape, not the blueprint's ceiling, and S3 owns that decision; (2) the blueprint states no proportion of multiple-response items, and the practice sources disagree (14%, 23%, 30%), so the per-domain format_mix is a documented authoring judgment rather than a measured value.

sources.citation: Official AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) Exam Guide, published by Amazon Web Services (docs.aws.amazon.com), 32 pp., PDF build date 2026-08-14 — the vendor publishes no version string and no change-history table for this exam. Public document, read in full 2026-08-16. Supplies the domain list and weights, 19 task statements and 135 objective bullets, item types, scoring model, scored/unscored item counts, canonical vocabulary, and the in-scope (100 offerings) and out-of-scope (46 offerings) AWS service lists. Distilled to derivation/source-clf-blueprint.md.

No derivation artefact — the four facts are recorded in derivation/sources.md.

provenance.nda_statement: This package contains no live exam content. Nothing here is drawn from the CLF-C02 item bank, and no question reproduces an item encountered in a real sitting. Actual exam content is confidential and protected by the AWS Certification NDA. Sources whose items trace back to candidate recall of a live sitting were screened out at S1 — nine candidate sources were rejected with recorded evidence, including two permissively licensed question banks that reproduce a known dump corpus's numbering. This is an independent study tool: it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Amazon Web Services, Inc. or Pearson VUE.
